Actual native double operand swap instead computes BA on safe square input. Named conditional study corrects only this duplicate operand swap, retaining source API descriptors/heuristic and FP32 switch fallthrough.

scientific_intent.accuracy_requirements: Exact all entries on declared bounded quarter-dyadic inputs, whose products/partial sums are representable even in BF16/F16. This controls API/layout/math correctness but does not stress arbitrary low-precision rounding or identify internal vendor accumulation instructions.
